scripts.text:
[O'Riley the Leprechaun]
Hmm...
Tis a fine day it be.
If you have a moment to spare.
Come here to me now, come here and I'll tell ya something.
scripts.translation:
[小妖精 奧萊利]
嗯...今天可真不錯。
有空的話，過來一下吧，我有件事想告訴你。

scripts.text: Go ahead.
scripts.translation: 你說吧

scripts.text:
[O'Riley the Leprechaun]
These past years I've come to see the world and each time the snakes have stolen me treasure.
scripts.translation:
[小妖精 奧萊利]
過去幾年裡，我四處遊歷，但每次我的財寶都會被蛇偷走。

scripts.text: Oh?
scripts.translation: 哦？

scripts.text:
[O'Riley the Leprechaun]
Ye fine folks of this land have been so gracious to recover me treasure again and again.
scripts.translation:
[小妖精 奧萊利]
這片土地上的好心人一次又一次地幫我找回了財寶，真是感激不盡。

scripts.text:
[O'Riley the Leprechaun]
I've learned me lesson and will never forget how those vile snakes have wronged me.
scripts.translation:
[小妖精 奧萊利]
我吸取了教訓，絕不會忘記那些卑鄙的蛇是如何欺負我的。

scripts.text: What did you do?
scripts.translation: 你做了什麼？

scripts.text:
[O'Riley the Leprechaun]
I made a safe place to hide me treasure.
Hidden in a secret place the treasure would be safe until I returned to the world the following year.
scripts.translation:
[小妖精 奧萊利]
我弄了個安全的地方，把財寶藏了起來。
藏在秘密地點，等我第二年再來時，財寶就能安然無恙。

scripts.text:
[O'Riley the Leprechaun]
This year, I have made me journey to see the outside world once again.
I traveled to me cache of gold I found it to be safe and undisturbed.
scripts.translation:
[小妖精 奧萊利]
今年，我又出來看外面的世界了。
我去了藏金子的地方，發現財寶安然無恙，沒人動過。

scripts.text:
[O'Riley the Leprechaun]
I thought to meself, I am very clever to hide the treasure from the snakes.
Oh, but I was a fool still.
scripts.translation:
[小妖精 奧萊利]
我當時心想，我真是聰明，把財寶藏得連蛇都找不到。
哦，但我還是個大傻瓜。

scripts.text: What happened?
scripts.translation: 發生了什麼？

scripts.text:
[O'Riley the Leprechaun]
My hiding place was too clever.
I pulled and I heaved and pushed, but the hiding place would not budge.
So once again, I am without treasure this year.
scripts.translation:
[小妖精 奧萊利]
可我這藏寶的辦法實在太巧妙了。
我又拉又推，拼命使勁，藏寶處卻紋絲不動。
所以今年，我又拿不到自己的財寶了。

scripts.text:
[O'Riley the Leprechaun]
I have not even begun brewing me famous green ale on account of this mess.
I will ask ye, will ya help get me treasure back?
scripts.translation:
[小妖精 奧萊利]
因為這件事，我連著名的綠色濃啤酒都還沒開始釀造。
我想問問你，你願意幫我找回財寶嗎？

scripts.text: Sure, I can help you.
scripts.translation: 當然，我來幫你

scripts.text: I'm too busy.
scripts.translation: 我太忙了

scripts.text:
[O'Riley the Leprechaun]
Aye, I understand.
Thank you for listening to me tale.
scripts.translation:
[小妖精 奧萊利]
啊，我理解。
謝謝你聽我講完這個故事。

scripts.text:
[O'Riley the Leprechaun]
To find my treasure it be true.
To my treasure I give my secret to you.
scripts.translation:
[小妖精 奧萊利]
要想找到我的財寶，就得知道這個秘密。
現在，我把秘密告訴你。

scripts.text:
[O'Riley the Leprechaun]
So, listen well and make no omissions.
Make the journey to the city of magicians.
Over the bridge and across the water
Climb the mountain until north ye can travel no farther.
scripts.translation:
[小妖精 奧萊利]
聽仔細了，可別漏掉一句。
前往魔法師之城。
跨過橋梁，越過水麵。
登上山，一直向北，直到無路可走。

scripts.text:
[O'Riley the Leprechaun]
Passed the stone steps set into the air.
Hidden in the mountain side, me treasure is there.
scripts.translation:
[小妖精 奧萊利]
走過那通向半空的石階。
我的財寶就藏在山壁之中。

scripts.text:
[O'Riley the Leprechaun]
Ye must find a way to break it open.
Ye will need a mighty explosion to free the cache to be sure.
scripts.translation:
[小妖精 奧萊利]
你得想辦法把藏寶處炸開。
得來一場猛烈的爆炸，才能取出財寶。

scripts.text:
[O'Riley the Leprechaun]
Ye might try some Firecrackers.
Course, Ye would need a great number of them, Ye would need at least ^FF0000200 Firecreackers^000000
scripts.translation:
[小妖精 奧萊利]
你可以試試用爆竹。
不過，你需要準備很多，至少需要^FF0000200個爆竹^000000。

scripts.text:
[O'Riley the Leprechaun]
Tis a fine day it be.
Have you found me treasure yet, have you?
Me hiding spot is a might hard to crack.
scripts.translation:
[小妖精 奧萊利]
今天天氣真不錯。
你找到我的財寶了嗎？
我的藏寶處可不容易開啟。

scripts.text:
[O'Riley the Leprechaun]
Ye might try some Firecrackers.
Course, Ye would need a great number of them, Ye would need at least ^FF0000200 Firecreackers^000000
scripts.translation:
[小妖精 奧萊利]
你可以試試用爆竹。
不過，你需要準備很多，至少需要^FF0000200個爆竹^000000。

scripts.text:
[O'Riley the Leprechaun]
I be understanding if you can't get to it to be sure to be sure.
scripts.translation:
[小妖精 奧萊利]
要是你取不出來，我也能理解，真的。

scripts.text:
[O'Riley the Leprechaun]
Oh, welcome back!
Thank you for returning me treasure!
Me gratitude knows no bounds!
scripts.translation:
[小妖精 奧萊利]
哦，歡迎回來！
謝謝你把我的財寶帶回來！
我的感激之情無以言表！

scripts.text:
[O'Riley the Leprechaun]
I am so happy,
I'll be starting up me brew right away
scripts.translation:
[小妖精 奧萊利]
我太高興了！
這就開始釀我的美酒。

scripts.text:
[O'Riley the Leprechaun]
It seems that the snakes have returned this year and are here to steal my treasure again.
scripts.translation:
[小妖精 奧萊利]
看來今年蛇又回來了，它們又想偷走我的財寶。

scripts.text:
[O'Riley the Leprechaun]
The snakes carry the coins of my kinsmen and must be punished.
But ye have had a long journey, for which I am very grateful.
scripts.translation:
[小妖精 奧萊利]
蛇身上帶著我族人的金幣，必須受到懲罰。
但你一路奔波辛苦了，我非常感激。

scripts.text:
[O'Riley the Leprechaun]
When ye have had a moment to rest ye legs, come talk to me again and we may speak again
scripts.translation:
[小妖精 奧萊利]
等你休息好了，再來找我，我們再好好聊聊。

scripts.text:
[O'Riley the Leprechaun]
Ah, well rested I hope?
scripts.translation:
[小妖精 奧萊利]
啊，休息好了嗎？

scripts.text:
[O'Riley the Leprechaun]
Thank you for coming by again.
The snakes carry the coins of my kindsmen and must be punished.
scripts.translation:
[小妖精 奧萊利]
謝謝你再次過來。
蛇身上帶著我族人的金幣，必須受到懲罰。

scripts.text:
[O'Riley the Leprechaun]
I would be so generous to give you some of my famous brew if you would bring me the ill-gotten gains carried by those vile snakes
scripts.translation:
[小妖精 奧萊利]
把那些可惡的蛇偷來的金幣帶給我，我就請你喝我聞名遐邇的美酒。

scripts.text: And if you find one of the treasures of my kin please bring me those coins so that the snakes don't get them.
scripts.translation: 如果你找到了我族人的財寶，請把這些金幣帶給我，別讓蛇拿到。

scripts.text:
[O'Riley the Leprechaun]
The snakes carry too many of me kinsmen's coin I be passing out pints of me brew as reward for their return.
scripts.translation:
[小妖精 奧萊利]
那些蛇偷走了我族人太多金幣。
幫忙把金幣帶回來的人，我都會送上美酒作為獎勵。

scripts.text:
[O'Riley the Leprechaun]
I'll reward ye with one jug of ale for ^0000FF1 Golden Coins^000000, ^0000FF5 Silver Coins^000000, or ^0000FF10 Bronze Coins^000000.
It be a fair bounty for the ill-gotten coins.
So, what kind of coin have ye brought?
scripts.translation:
[小妖精 奧萊利]
帶來^0000FF1枚金幣^000000、^0000FF5枚銀幣^000000或^0000FF10枚銅幣^000000，就能換一罐啤酒。
幫忙追回這些贓款，給這樣的獎勵很公道吧。
那麼，你帶來了哪種硬幣？

scripts.text: Bronze Coins
scripts.translation: 銅幣

scripts.text: Silver Coins
scripts.translation: 銀幣

scripts.text: Gold Coins
scripts.translation: 金幣

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[O'Riley the Leprechaun]
Thank you. Here's your ale~
scripts.translation:
[小妖精 奧萊利]
謝謝。這是你的啤酒~

scripts.text:
[O'Riley the Leprechaun]
Thank you. Here's your ale~
scripts.translation:
[小妖精 奧萊利]
謝謝。這是你的啤酒~

scripts.text:
[O'Riley the Leprechaun]
Thank you. Here's your ale~
scripts.translation:
[小妖精 奧萊利]
謝謝。這是你的啤酒~

scripts.text:
[O'Riley the Leprechaun]
I'll reward ye with one jug of ale for ^0000FF1 Golden Coins^000000, ^0000FF5 Silver Coins^000000, or ^0000FF10 Bronze Coins^000000.
scripts.translation:
[小妖精 奧萊利]
帶來^0000FF1枚金幣^000000、^0000FF5枚銀幣^000000或^0000FF10枚銅幣^000000，就能換一罐啤酒。

scripts.text: - You've found a pile of rocks covered with soil. -
scripts.translation: - 你發現了一堆覆蓋著土壤的岩石。 -

scripts.text: - You've found a pile of rocks covered with soil. -
scripts.translation: - 你發現了一堆覆蓋著土壤的岩石。 -

scripts.text:
The rocks won't budge.
Maybe O'Riley knows a way to move the rocks.
scripts.translation:
岩石紋絲不動。
也許奧萊利知道怎麼移開這些岩石。

scripts.text: Use Firecrackers.
scripts.translation: 使用爆竹

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 無視

scripts.text:
You buried 200 Firecrackers under the pile of rocks.
You light the fuse.
scripts.translation:
你在岩石堆下埋了200個爆竹。
你點燃了引線。

scripts.text: *BOOM!*

After A cloud of dust and smoke has dissipated,
You've found a box between the rocks and soil.
This box must contain O'Riley's valuables.
Let's bring the box to O'Riley.
scripts.translation:
塵土和煙霧散去後，你在岩石與泥土之間發現了一個箱子。
裡面一定裝著奧萊利的財寶。
把箱子帶給奧萊利吧。
